messages.subject: TPI Polene Power | Waste-to-energy, ESG and stakeholder execution
messages.body:
Dear TPI Polene Power Leadership Team,

TPI Polene Power's waste-to-energy and renewable power platform aligns directly with my experience across industrial sustainability, energy transition and stakeholder governance.

I currently serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My responsibilities span government and regulatory relations, ESG, social performance, corporate coordination and executive stakeholder strategy.

My recent work includes governance and external engagement around approximately 46 to 50 MWp of solar capacity and more than 80 MWh of battery storage, together with carbon-data readiness using physical operating records. I also manage environmental regulator interfaces and community-sensitive issues.

I would welcome consideration for Thailand or regional roles across Sustainability, Government Relations, Corporate Affairs, Strategic Partnerships or energy-sector stakeholder leadership. I have attached a TPI Polene Power-focused executive CV for review.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
